title: Mystic Sorceress with Orb
description: A female figure in ornate patterned armor and flowing robes stands in profile, holding a glowing orb containing an octopus-like creature. She is set against a swirling pink and purple cosmic vortex, a white crescent moon, a barren tree with a hidden face, and a small silhouetted figure on red mountains below.
